review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new concept it introduces is the bundled `CoalgHom` with its `CoalgHomClass`. Mathlib has no other coalgebra morphism type, and the file is the base of the `CoalgEquiv`, `BialgHom` and `CoalgCat` developments. It follows the standard `FunLike`/`HomClass` pattern, so I found no competing version. `counitCoalgHom` is a named wrapper. Grep shows its only use outside this file is `counitBialgHom` in `Bialgebra/Hom.lean`, and that use builds on it. `subsingleton_to_ring` and `Repr.induced` add new content rather than copies. `CoalgHom.End` is the usual monoid structure on endomorphisms. I found no justified finding.
